question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle A=50^\circ\) and \(\angle B=60^\circ\). In \(\triangle DEF\), \(\angle D=50^\circ\) and \(\angle F=70^\circ\). How are these two triangles related?
solution: \(\angle C=180^\circ-50^\circ-60^\circ=70^\circ\), so \(\angle A=\angle D\) and \(\angle C=\angle F\). Two pairs of corresponding angles are equal, so the triangles are similar.
